content: BraiAn = BraiAnDetect (QuPath extension, multichannel whole-brain cell detection, <40 min/brain on a regular desktop) + BraiAnalyse (Python library) for section-to-animal-to-group aggregation. BraiAnalyse's braian.stats submodule provides prebuilt density calculations, percentage metrics, fold-change, and marker-overlap indices, chaining aggregation from single sections to single animals to groups while keeping data attributed to the atlas hierarchy. Full detail on weighting/summing rules not available from public docs excerpt; API reference recommended for exact aggregation formulas.
